title: Mass bound for the competitor Z + f_#X when f fixes Z on G and Y = Z + X
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, G ⊆ ℝ^P open with G ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained G U: closure G is compact and contained in U), O ⊆ ℝ^P open with G ⊆ O, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O, and Λ ≥ 0 with ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ Λ for every x ∈ G (Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x, operator norm). Let RZ = (M_Z, θ_Z, ξ_Z), RX = (M_X, θ_X, ξ_X) and RY = (M_Y, θ_Y, ξ_Y) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n) and Y, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and write τ(R)(ω) := R.action ω = ∫_{M_R} θ_R ξ_R(ω) dHⁿ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume: RY represents Y; Y(ω) = τ(RZ)(ω) + τ(RX)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_Z ∩ G (i.e. Hⁿ⌞(M_Z ∩ G)-a.e.), f(x) = x and ξ_Z(x)(α∘Df(x)) = ξ_Z(x)(α) for every n-covector α; Hⁿ(M_X ∖ G) = 0; and S(ω) = τ(RZ)(ω) + ∫_{M_X} θ_X(x)·ξ_X(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then M_G(S) ≤ Λⁿ·μ_{RY}(G), i.e. S.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Λⁿ)·RY.measure G, where M_G(S) is the supremum of S(ω) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with spt ω ⊆ G and |ω(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z (Simon 6.2.5, Euclidean coefficient norm) and μ_{RY} = θ_Y·Hⁿ⌞M_Y.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G O : Set (Euclid P)) (RZ RX RY : IMRep U n) (Y S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen G → CompactlyContained G U → IsOpen O → G ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ x ∈ G, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ) → RY.Represents Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = RZ.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + RX.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (RZ.carrier ∩ G)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, RZ.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = RZ.orient x α) → μHE[n] (RX.carrier \ G) = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = RZ.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + ∫ x in RX.carrier, (RX.mult x : ℝ) * RX.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → S.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Λ ^ n) * RY.measure G
